body.x: lululab recognized at the annual awards from 2019 through 2022 for the company's LUMINI series, a series of beauty/dermatological analysis tools based on AI technologies

lululab, was recently named a CES Innovation Awards honoree for the fourth consecutive year (2019–2022) at the Consumer Electronics Show (CES) 2022, held in New York City. lululab is a startup specializing in AI beauty solutions.
At CES 2022, lululab gained recognition by winning the Innovation Award in two award categories: Health & Wellness and Software & Mobile Apps.

Lumini App(SDK), winner of the Innovation Award in the Software & Mobile Apps category, is an AI-powered skin care service that provides detailed skin analysis (especially for trouble) from type, severity, to the personalized prescription of optimal skin products. Skin can be now diagnosed anywhere with the option of online consultation, monitoring, and offline visit. This solution will be available in the form of “customizable SDK” for any companies who wish to provide personalized service to the customers.

lululab CEO Yongjoon Choe commented on the awards, saying, "As a startup, we are honored to have been recognized so many times by the CES Innovation Awards for our AI-based dermatological analysis and beauty treatments. CES 2022 was especially significant in that our products were recognized for their ability to address many parts of the body. Moving forward, lululab will focus on providing customers with individualized, data-based services."

CES is the world's largest international tech trade show and is traditionally held annually in Las Vegas. The Consumer Technology Association, which hosts the event, evaluates products featured at the CES based on their innovativeness in a wide range of categories, including design, functionality, and user value.
